status: Experimental policies rejected for production promotion; no app or core solver edits.

study.method: Fresh fixed-count/phase diagnostic; only row-DP initialization resolution varies. All candidates use the same original probability/mask, 16 controls, 18 DP rounds, 150 near-miss/fine/clearance steps and 750 free-curve steps with no deadlines. This is not a full count search, production solve, 10-second benchmark or ground-truth reconstruction. No saved geometry is read. Standard cleanup and final sharing are not applied.

fixture.provenance: Frozen offline foreground-model crop with a bounded rejected-lobe search. No cutting template or solver feedback was used to generate these corners; they remain needs_review, not ground truth. The old fitter discards the 3+3 color-retaining seed at 9.274% coarse error, changes the routing, and exports a rejected 4.698% mask fit.

features.method: Both colours; four-connected interior source regions with a solid core. At least 60% of each region must remain its original colour. Regions touching the border or its one-pixel neighbourhood, and tiny or thin classification fragments, are excluded. All observed pixels still enter the image-error measurement.

limitations: Floating-point chord-based intersection checks, not exact algebraic predicates.
Samples on a target cut within twice the geometry tolerance have no unambiguous colour and are counted separately.

paper.method: Guarded disk-centre lattice on the unfolded capsule. Four-neighbour connectivity; analytic outline and chord-distance refinement near threshold.
limitations: This replaces the Python GEOS offset implementation; numerical results are not identical.
Pass/fail concern this guarded discrete rolling-disk model, not stress or tear resistance.
Uncertain is not accepted by the strict material-core gate. Increase resolution to investigate.
Small tips and features below the explicitly stated area threshold are not certified.

replay.method: Fresh end-to-end image solves in isolated module copies. Baseline is unchanged. replace-feature changes every feature-search DP grid to 98 samples. nearby adds 94/98-sample candidates only after a successful base-count near-miss rescue, preserving the original as an alternative. No acceptance threshold changes. Original-photo offsets are fixed before fitting. Four controls and six other translations are development evidence, not independent held-out motif families.
